summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service filed an 8-K updating its at-the-market equity program with Pacific Century Securities and post-reverse-split share count. As of September 25, 2026, roughly 196,850,000 pre-split Class A shares had been sold under the $35,280,213.01 ATM facility established August 21, 2026. A 1-for-150 reverse split became market effective September 28, 2026, leaving about 1,332,087 Class A and 1,358 Class B shares outstanding. This is a routine capital-markets disclosure, not a special situation; watch ongoing dilution and Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance risk.
